## Summary
Describe the change and linked Issue.

## Scope
- [ ] Only approved files changed
- [ ] No secret, customer data, unverified archive, or unrelated project modified
- [ ] No deployment or destructive operation without separate approval

## Validation
- [ ] Relevant automated tests executed (or explain why not)
- [ ] Build/lint verified (or explain why not)
- [ ] Manual UI, accessibility and responsive checks documented if applicable
- [ ] Database changes include migration and rollback strategy if applicable

## Evidence and risks
Logs, test results, screenshots, known limitations, and rollback instructions.
